title: Studio visual preflight review (still or motion evidence)
description: Review of bounded visual evidence only (native still frames / sparse decoded motion samples + contact sheet). A pass is a preflight pass, not final approval: sparse motion samples cannot certify full continuous movement or musical taste. For stage 'still', checks.motion_quality true explicitly means not-applicable (no motion was presented), never a motion judgement. Prefer false for any applicable check whose evidence is unavailable. This review binds an evidence digest only; it carries no PR head SHA and is not the full mechanical QA review.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact evidence.json bytes reviewed.

evidence_reviewed.description: The actual attached frames/contact sheet were inspected.

brief_adherence.description: The evidence implements the provided brief within executable controls.

visual_quality.description: Composition, shape, readability and style consistency are acceptable.

motion_quality.description: For stage motion: sampled movement is acceptable (sparse samples only, not full-movement certification). For stage still: true explicitly means not-applicable.

enum: audio listening unavailable; not a full musical judgement
